summary.en: Complex generics, inhaled medicines and biosimilars dominate development. Named clinical-stage disclosure is limited, with much of the pipeline presented as product categories and launch ambitions.
summary.zh: 复杂仿制药、吸入药物和生物类似药主导研发。已披露的临床阶段项目有限，管线大部分以产品类别和上市目标形式呈现。

ind.zh: 肿瘤；以印度为重点的临床开发
肿瘤；以印度为重点的临床开发

ind.en: Buruli ulcer; also tuberculosis and leprosy development
ind.zh: Buruli溃疡；另有结核病和麻风病开发

watch.en: Tarapur, Mandideep Unit-1 and Pithampur Unit-II remain remediation sites.
watch.zh: Tarapur、Mandideep Unit-1和Pithampur Unit-II仍为整改场地。

watch.en: US and India represented 39% and 31% of Q2 FY2027 sales, respectively.
watch.zh: 美国和印度分别占2027财年第二季度销售额的39%和31%。

watch.en: Company targets six biosimilar filings in regulated markets by 2029.
watch.zh: 公司目标在2029年前于受监管市场提交六项生物类似药申报。

watch.en: TB Alliance leads telacebec clinical work; Lupin supports manufacturing and regulatory activities.
watch.zh: TB Alliance主导telacebec临床工作；Lupin支持生产和监管事务。

sources: TB Alliance: collaboration and active Phase 2 trial, January 2026
Ophthalmology: aflibercept developed at Pune facility
gaps: No complete current asset-by-phase pipeline or company phase totals verified.
Numbered phases for nivolumab and pembrolizumab remain undisclosed in reviewed company materials; null.
Denosumab registration reflects Japan submission; aflibercept registration reflects India submission. Later decisions in these markets were not verified.
Targets, asset-specific milestone dates and origins other than aflibercept were not established; null. Telacebec collaboration responsibilities do not establish discovery origin.
Ranibizumab and pegfilgrastim are already approved and excluded.

The January 2026 TB Alliance release predates June 2026; its active Phase 2 Buruli ulcer study supplies telacebec's phase. The FY2026 review covers the year ending March 2026; November quarterly materials provide no newer numbered phases for these assets.
